purpose: Public research starting points, NOT source approval, automatic crawl allowlist or photo permission.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 OECD performance abstracts
sources.scope: Model and approval-number discovery; manufacturer-consented Code 2 abstracts only; verify exact transmission, approval number and test conditions.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 2026 approvals
sources.scope: Prioritize 2026 approvals and all paginated entries; list entries are identities, not complete measured facts.

sources.name: OECD tractor codes
sources.scope: Separate Code 2 performance from protective structures and noise; do not infer measurements from standards.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 testing stations
sources.scope: Discover national testing bodies; a station listing is not an individual test report.

sources.name: CFMTTI Budni test report summaries
sources.scope: Annual lists of commercial/initial/batch tests. Use original exact report and variant; report date is not model year.

sources.name: CFMTTI tested machines
sources.scope: Discover tested models, then resolve report and OEM source.

sources.name: Nebraska Tractor Test Lab
sources.scope: Public reports where available; do not purchase reports without authorization.

sources.name: UNL DigitalCommons tractor lab
sources.scope: Historic and modern test publications; use exact report ID and generation.

sources.name: Nebraska government documents
sources.scope: Annual historic summaries; preserve year, tested equipment and source.

sources.name: DLG report database
sources.scope: Measured report data only for matched configuration.

sources.name: DLG PowerMix
sources.scope: Keep workload, transport and field cycles distinct; do not convert g/kWh into L/h without valid assumptions.

sources.name: TAMTEST
sources.scope: Official testing and approval context; report access not guaranteed.

sources.name: NARO safety inspection results
sources.scope: Japanese model/market identity and explicitly listed safety equipment; no inferred performance or model year.

sources.name: NARO test methods
sources.scope: Distinguish safety inspection, ROPS and automation from performance tests.

sources.name: KoAT agricultural machinery
sources.scope: Official Korean machinery testing program; retrieve individual public reports separately.

sources.name: KoAT 2025 testing annual report announcement
sources.scope: Discover report publication; announcement is not a model technical table.

sources.name: Josephinum tractor reports
sources.scope: Use accessible actual reports and test codes.

sources.name: Estacion Mecanica Agricola
sources.scope: Official Spanish test station; obtain specific reports before using numeric data.

sources.name: Chinese Ministry of Agriculture machinery appraisal
sources.scope: Official test standard announcement; discover current model-specific approvals separately.

sources.name: INRAE Agate
sources.scope: Historical test documentation; check access, date, identity and reuse.

sources.name: UFSM Agrotecnologia
sources.scope: Academic test methods and references; obtain actual study before assigning facts.

sources.name: Iowa State agricultural machinery literature
sources.scope: Historic catalogue evidence; item-specific rights.

sources.name: Wageningen Special Collections
sources.scope: Historical brochures/manuals; engineering photo collection has CC BY-NC 4.0, do not reuse commercially without separate permission.

sources.name: McCormick-International Harvester Collection
sources.scope: Production records, catalogues, photos; item-level permission; no presumed open licence.

sources.name: Allison tractor manuals collection
sources.scope: Finding aid; digitization and access not guaranteed.

sources.name: TractorData
sources.scope: Secondary independent discovery and cross-check only; follow primary sources; respect rights, no bulk reproduction.

sources.name: Finna
sources.scope: Search tractor/traktori/Valmet/Valtra and local model names. Metadata CC0 is not image licence. Require item-specific commercial and derivative permission.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.scope: Only item-specific CC0 media; distinguish real full-size tractors from toy/model objects.

sources.name: Library of Congress FSA-OWI
sources.scope: Historical photos; verify rights advisory and original agency/creator, copied images may be restricted.

sources.name: Digital Public Library of America
sources.scope: Aggregator; follow original institution and item rights; no blanket permission.

sources.name: Europeana agricultural machinery
sources.scope: Follow original provider and per-object rights, no aggregator licence assumption.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.scope: Existing Commons provider; file-specific rights, source and visual identity. Respect Retry-After.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.scope: Existing Flickr/Europeana integration, only leads; verify original provider metadata and original file.

sources.name: Flickr
sources.scope: Use only creator-specific permitted works and original rights, never assume all photos reusable.

sources.name: Kubota Japan tractor manual index
sources.scope: Observed 1079 search results across 44 pages on 2026-11-24; not 1079 unique tractors. Model codes and power labels may include variants. Deduplicate manual URLs and inspect exact manual revision, model column, measurement definition and domestic market. No automatic download or photo rights.

sources.name: Yanmar Japan tractor and JD manual index
sources.scope: Paginated multi-model manuals, including CT crawler tractors. Also contains implements; exclude non-tractor equipment and do not infer manufacturer from category. Public accessible manuals only.

sources.name: Yanmar Japan current agricultural catalogues
sources.scope: 2026 comprehensive catalogues and shared YT tractor series brochures. Large document sizes require existing bounded offline PDF tools; review exact suffix, equipment and page/column. No automatic reuse of illustrations.

sources.name: India Ministry farm mechanization platform
sources.scope: Public machinery model discovery only. Never collect farmer, dealer personal data, application, registration, engine or chassis identifiers. Subsidy eligibility is not measured performance.

sources.name: Bihar government approved active model list
sources.scope: Public manufacturer/model-list discovery only, availability and filters may vary. No beneficiary or registration information. Confirm exact tractor report and OEM specification.

sources.name: Assam government tractor model lists
sources.scope: Published approved model list by PTO power category. Actual PDF rows not reviewed in this pass; category is not measured power.

sources.name: Swiss FEDRO vehicle data
sources.scope: Public type approval data where available; verify data dictionary, licence, vehicle class and exact model. Some data products are fee-based; do not buy. No individual vehicle or owner information.

sources.name: Netherlands RDW open vehicle data
sources.scope: Public dataset discovery; evaluate schema and vehicle category before using aggregated manufacturer/model identities only. Never retrieve or retain plate, owner or individual vehicle identifiers. Registration year is not model year.

sources.name: US EPA annual engine certification data
sources.scope: Nonroad compression ignition engine-family data; exact family and year crosswalk to OEM tractor engine required. Engine certificate alone does not prove installed tractor power, configuration or emissions standard in another market.

sources.name: Brazil IBAMA agricultural engine certification
sources.scope: MAR-I licensing process; no actual model-level certificate accessed. Never infer approval or emissions values from process or proposed rules.

sources.name: FAO AGRIS multilingual agricultural research
sources.scope: AGROVOC and scholarly metadata for local-language research discovery. Obtain original publication, exact measured tractor and test methodology. Bibliographic entry is not technical evidence.

sources.name: Crossref public scholarly metadata
sources.scope: DOI metadata and original studies; free public API within current terms and limits. Full-text availability, licence and study scope must be checked separately.

sources.name: DigitalNZ collections
sources.scope: Free metadata API, access requirements and limits to be checked at execution; source item image rights are separate. Historical tractor and agricultural engineering photos, not guaranteed new models.

sources.name: National Library of Australia collections
sources.scope: Public catalogue and individual items only where access permits. Trove API restrictions require separate eligibility review, do not assume access. Verify original photograph public-domain status or explicit commercial derivative licence.

sources.name: Commons structured data discovery
sources.scope: Combine category and depicts P180 for candidate discovery where exact Wikidata entity is known. Incomplete metadata; no automatic identity or rights approval. Same existing request budget; replace low-yield calls, never add uncontrolled requests.

sources.name: Commons Agritechnica 2025 photo category
sources.scope: Event/brand subcategories as shared source groups; verified subcategories for Basak, VST, Preet and TYM. Category membership is not model identification. Exclude equipment/toys and inspect actual original badge and individual licence.

sources.name: IIIF presentation rights and attribution
sources.scope: Institutional scan manifests can locate images and catalogue pages. Inspect image-level rights, requiredStatement and underlying source; manifest or thumbnail does not grant commercial image rights.

sources.name: John Deere equipment publications
sources.scope: Search model and publication language; public listing only, some manuals require purchase or dealer access. Exclude serial-specific lookup and never bypass paid access.

sources.name: AGCO service and information
sources.scope: Discover brand-specific Fendt, Massey Ferguson and Valtra resources. Login and paid parts or manual platforms are not authorized for collection.

sources.name: Massey Ferguson tractor brochure library
sources.scope: Free public series documents where available; retain market, date, power standard, and model column. No implied photo reuse.

sources.name: Massey Ferguson Türkiye brochure library
sources.scope: Turkish regional series catalogue; compare to global version without merging market-specific specs.

sources.name: Case IH operator manuals information
sources.scope: Owner FieldOps access described; use only genuinely public material and no account or owner-only access without authorization.

sources.name: CLAAS tractor series
sources.scope: Manufacturer advertises over 50 models; enumerate regional series and exact brochures, not a count of unique new records.

sources.name: CLAAS UK tractor range
sources.scope: Cross-check UK equipment and power ratings separately from North America.

sources.name: TYM international download library
sources.scope: Public model brochures, parts catalogues and manuals; verify post-merger TYM/Branson aliases and editions, do not equate similar machines.

sources.name: TYM North America download library
sources.scope: Regional documents, distinct gear/HST/cab variations and source revisions. Public files only.

sources.name: KIOTI North America tractor index
sources.scope: Manufacturer model pages and downloadable resources; exact submodel suffix, drivetrain, and market.

sources.name: KIOTI Europe tractor range
sources.scope: European series, emissions and regional aliases; don't copy US variants.

sources.name: LS Tractor manufacturer range
sources.scope: Global manufacturer model discovery; regional model name and exact source document required.

sources.name: LS Tractor USA range
sources.scope: Regional compact/utility model list; verify actual equipment and manual model codes.

sources.name: Solis global brochure library
sources.scope: Multi-model technical catalogues; retain market, drive, cab, and standard versus optional equipment.

sources.name: Solis Yanmar India brochure library
sources.scope: Model-specific Indian brochures; never silently merge Indian and Turkish specifications.

sources.name: Mahindra India tractor range
sources.scope: Manufacturer range, model page and source-specific facts; compare existing catalogue first.

sources.name: Sonalika full tractor range
sources.scope: Discover exact variants and public model brochures, don't infer from HP category or price.

sources.name: VST India tractor catalogue
sources.scope: Compact, orchard and utility models; exclude implements and ambiguous VST-Zetor branding.

sources.name: YTO tractor products
sources.scope: Series and model discovery from manufacturer catalogue; verify local/export configuration and actual model data. Series HP range is not per-model power.

sources.name: Agrale Brazil tractor range
sources.scope: Portuguese OEM product pages; confirm exact document edition and market, do not merge conflicting older specifications.

sources.name: Zetor current product range
sources.scope: Current series discovery; verify specific model and 2026 release status with dated OEM evidence.

sources.name: Zetor non-EU range
sources.scope: Non-EU product catalogue; keep variants separate from EU Stage V.

sources.name: Hattat tractor range
sources.scope: Manufacturer series and shared technical documents; exact Turkish market and Stage III/V differentiation.

sources.name: Tractor Manufacturers Association member companies
sources.scope: Brand discovery for Captain, PREET, VST, Trakstar and others; member listing does not prove a model or technical fact. Follow exact manufacturer public sources only.

sources.name: SDF Historical Archives
sources.scope: More than 360,000 reported mixed archival records, not unique tractors or photos. SAME, Deutz-Fahr, Lamborghini, Huerlimann and other group brands. Many manuals paid; no purchases. Public catalogue may support identity and factual research.

sources.name: SDF historical catalogue and reproduction conditions
sources.scope: Reproduction subject to permission and attribution, no assumed right to alter images. Do not use photos or scans as site assets without explicit compatible grant.

sources.name: CREA tractor certifications
sources.scope: Italian OECD testing authority and certification process; retrieve exact public approved test report for numeric facts.

sources.name: USDA ARS Image Gallery
sources.scope: USDA images generally public domain unless otherwise indicated; check individual source, official-duty authorship and credit. Generic farm equipment photo is not exact model evidence.

sources.name: US National Archives photographs
sources.scope: Original government collection and historical images. Not all NARA items are public domain; inspect item and series Use Restrictions and original creator.

sources.name: Swedish National Museum of Science and Technology image archive
sources.scope: DigitaltMuseum images and technical industrial history. Verify each original item, rights and exact tractor model; no blanket commercial permission.

sources.name: Finnish Heritage Agency collections
sources.scope: Institution-specific collections in Finna; extra search facet, not a separate API provider. Original photographer, collection and image-specific rights required.

sources.name: University of Nebraska tractor test museum collections
sources.scope: Historic tractor identity, model history and test equipment. Photos require separate rights review, not all digitized materials are reusable.

sources.name: Western Development Museum agricultural machinery
sources.scope: Historic Canadian farm machinery identity discovery. Museum collection photographs are not automatically licensed for reuse.

sources.name: University of Winnipeg Western Canada pictorial index tractors
sources.scope: Subject-indexed historical tractor photographs. Review source item rights and actual model. No automated orders or fee-based requests.

sources.name: Wikimedia tractor events category
sources.scope: Discover event and regional brand categories using existing Commons request budget. Membership alone is neither identity nor license evidence.
